name: canvas-lint
description: CanvasLint — A DevTools browser extension for debugging HTML5 Canvas 2D rendering

scripts.dev: vite build --watch & vite build -c vite.config.content.ts --watch & vite build -c vite.config.inject.ts --watch
scripts.build: vite build && vite build -c vite.config.content.ts && vite build -c vite.config.inject.ts
scripts.preview: npm run build && echo 'Load the dist/ folder as an unpacked extension'
